validity.billingJoin: billing_key and service timestamp >= valid_from and service timestamp < valid_to
validity.serviceSiteJoin: service_key and interval overlap, clipped to mapping and contract validity
validity.unknownIdentity: Null account_key remains unresolved; do not coalesce to a real account.
validity.numericKeyEquality: Forbidden across namespaces; billing key 2 is deliberately reused.

aggregation.sql: Trusted offline home-table arithmetic, not DAX execution. Recompute non-additive measures from rows.
aggregation.semi_additive: Filter/group by one dateColumn value per result; never sum different snapshot dates.
aggregation.active_accounts_eom: One month per result and a distinct account count; never sum across account-overlapping groups.
aggregation.money: Integer cents. Do not label cents as dollars.
aggregation.snapshot: Only observed snapshot dates exist. Do not infer unobserved end-of-month balances.

quarantine.ORPHAN_ACCOUNT: Exclude corrupt record; preserve valid null digital identities.
quarantine.DUPLICATE_NATURAL_ID: Exclude duplicate account ID; duplicate display names remain valid.
quarantine.OVERLAPPING_IDENTITY_INTERVAL: Exclude ambiguous billing interval; valid reuse is disjoint.
